title: Wanderlane Traveller Club Benefit Allowance Schedule
content:
This schedule is the allowance a participating lounge, airline handler or property reads against a traveller presenting a Wanderlane Traveller Club card. Eight entitlements are recorded against each tier.

## Air and lounge entitlements

The bag figure is the checked bags carried free on air bookings made while holding the tier. Priority boarding and priority check-in are recorded as granted or not granted by the tier. The lounge pass figure is the single-visit lounge passes granted each membership year, and the guest figure is the guests admitted with the member on one lounge visit. The companion figure is the companion vouchers granted each membership year.

| Tier | Free checked bags | Priority boarding | Priority check-in | Lounge passes a membership year | Guests on one visit | Companion vouchers a membership year |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wanderlane Blue | 0 | not granted | not granted | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Wanderlane Silver | 0 | not granted | not granted | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Wanderlane Gold | 1 | granted | not granted | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| Wanderlane Platinum | 1 | granted | granted | 4 | 1 | 1 |
| Wanderlane Titanium | 2 | granted | granted | 8 | 2 | 1 |
| Wanderlane Ambassador | 2 | granted | granted | 12 | 3 | 2 |

A lounge pass and a guest allowance are separate figures: Wanderlane Gold carries 2 passes a membership year and a guest allowance of 0, so its passes admit the member alone.

## Hotel stay entitlements

Guaranteed late checkout is recorded as granted or not granted on hotel stays. The upgrade position is the position in the room-upgrade queue, where 1 is served first and 0 means not queued.

| Tier | Guaranteed late checkout | Room-upgrade queue position |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Wanderlane Blue | not granted | 0 |
| Wanderlane Silver | not granted | 0 |
| Wanderlane Gold | granted | 4 |
| Wanderlane Platinum | granted | 3 |
| Wanderlane Titanium | granted | 2 |
| Wanderlane Ambassador | granted | 1 |

The queue position runs against the order of the tiers rather than with it: Wanderlane Ambassador holds position 1 and is served first, then Wanderlane Titanium at 2, Wanderlane Platinum at 3 and Wanderlane Gold at 4, while Wanderlane Blue and Wanderlane Silver are recorded at 0 and are not queued.
